digo_source: Mgombato ('podzo mung bean, green gram'; 'choroko mung bean'); Pakia ('Podzo', light and dark varieties)

teaser.en: Cook these little green beans with rice and you have *mshombo*, a comforting coastal favourite.
teaser.sw: Pika punje hizi ndogo za kijani pamoja na mchele upate *mshombo*, chakula cha pwani kinachopendwa na kinachoburudisha.
teaser.dg: Jita tembe hizi ndide za chijani phamwenga na mtele, nawe undaphaha *mshombo*, chakurya cha pwani chinachomendzwa ni anji na chinachotuliza moyo.

summary.en: *Podzo* is green gram or mung bean, a small bushy pulse that grows quickly in a short season. It is cooked in coconut milk or with rice as *mshombo*.
summary.sw: *Podzo* ni pojo au choroko, mmea mdogo wa jamii ya kunde wenye matawi mengi unaokua haraka katika msimu mfupi. Hupikwa kwa tui la nazi au pamoja na mchele kama *mshombo*.
summary.dg: *Podzo* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde wenye magongo manji, unaokula haraka kpwa msimu mfupi. Nkujitwa kpwa huwi, au ichijitwa phamwenga na mtele inakala *mshombo*.

about.en:
*Podzo* is a small, bushy bean plant with leaves of three leaflets and small yellow flowers. Its slender, hairy pods hold rows of small, round, olive-green seeds.

Digo farmers distinguish light and dark varieties.
about.sw:
*Podzo* ni mmea mdogo wa jamii ya maharagwe wenye matawi mengi, wenye majani ya vijani vitatu na maua madogo ya manjano. Maganda yake membamba yenye manyoya yana safu za mbegu ndogo, za mviringo, za rangi ya kijani-zeituni.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hutofautisha aina zenye rangi hafifu na zenye rangi iliyokolea.
about.dg:
*Podzo* ni mmea mdide wa kunde wenye magongo manji. Makodzage ganamera mahahu-mahahu, na maruwage ni madide, ga rangi ya mandano. Makakayage ni membamba na gana nyere, na ndani gana mistari ya tembe ndide za duara, za rangi ya chijani cha kufifia.

Akurima Adigo anatafwautisha aina za rangi ya kufifia na aina za rangi ya giza.

where.en: *Podzo* is a short-season pulse, planted to make the most of short rains and harvested quickly. It is grown on family farms and sold dried in every market.
where.sw: *Podzo* ni zao la mikunde la msimu mfupi, linalopandwa ili kutumia vyema mvua za vuli na kuvunwa haraka. Hupandwa kwenye mashamba ya familia na huuzwa likiwa limekaushwa katika kila soko.
where.dg: *Podzo* ni zao ra msimu mfupi: nkuphandwa ili kuhumira vinono mvula za vuri, na nkuvunwa haraka. Nkurimwa kpwenye minda ya mbari, na nkuguzwa ichikala kavu chila sokoni.

uses.en: The seeds are cooked in coconut milk. Cooked with rice, they make *mshombo*.
uses.sw: Mbegu hupikwa kwa tui la nazi. Zikipikwa pamoja na mchele, hutengeneza *mshombo*.
uses.dg: Tembe nkujitwa kpwa huwi. Zichijitwa phamwenga na mtele, zinakala *mshombo*.

names.en: Digo: *podzo*, also *choroko*. Swahili: *pojo* or *choroko*. English: green gram or mung bean. Scientists call it *Vigna radiata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *podzo*, pia *choroko*. Kiswahili: *pojo* au *choroko*. Kwa Kiingereza: *green gram* au *mung bean*. Wanasayansi huuita *Vigna radiata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *podzo*, piya *choroko*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *pojo* au *choroko*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *green gram* au *mung bean*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Vigna radiata*.

reason.en: Cowpea, another Vigna cooked in coconut
reason.sw: Kunde, Vigna nyingine inayopikwa kwa nazi
Njugu mawe, nayo ni jamii ya Vigna

reason.en: Rice, cooked with green gram as mshombo
reason.sw: Mpunga, mchele wake hupikwa pamoja na pojo kuwa mshombo
Mbaazi, jamii nyingine ya mikunde ya pwani
reason.dg: *Mbalazi*, zao ranjina ra jamii ya kunde ra pwani

definition.en: Mung bean; Mgombato's other word alongside podzo. Mgombato's only gloss is 'mung bean', so it is unclear whether choroko names the beans or the plant.
definition.sw: Pojo; neno lingine la Mgombato pamoja na podzo. Maana pekee inayotolewa na Mgombato ni 'mung bean', hivyo haijulikani wazi kama choroko ni jina la punje au la mmea.
definition.dg: *Podzo*; ni neno ranjina ra Mgombato phamwenga na *podzo*. Mgombato inalavya mana mwenga tu, 'mung bean', kpwa hivyo tagamanyikana kukala *choroko* ni dzina ra tembe au ra mmea.

mgombato: podzo (-) mung bean, green gram; pojo. (See: choroko)
